name: Dock
description: A row of icon buttons that grow toward the pointer, like an app launcher. Every item is a real button or link with a visible label (a tooltip) that is also its accessible name. Magnification is off on touch and for reduced motion.

label.description: Accessible name of the toolbar, for example Applications.

orientation.description: Layout direction and which arrow keys move focus.

magnification.description: Scale of the item directly under the pointer. 1 turns magnification off.

distance.description: Pixels from the pointer within which items grow.

isPaused.description: Turns magnification off. Items still enlarge slightly on focus.

keyboard: Tab moves into the dock on one item and out again (roving focus)
Left and Right arrows (Up and Down when vertical) move between items, swapped in right-to-left layouts
Home and End jump to the first and last item
Enter or Space activates the focused item
requirements: Each item is a real button (or a link when it has an href) named by its label
The label also shows as a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus
Focus enlarges the focused item too, so keyboard users get the same feedback
Magnification does not run on touch, for prefers-reduced-motion, in a .rdm-still container or when isPaused is set
Scaling is visual only: layout does not shift and hit areas stay at least 24px
Forced colors: items keep a visible border and focus ring
screenReader: Announced as a toolbar with its label; each item as a button or link with its label

use_when: A small set of app-level shortcuts or tools
anti_patterns: Hiding essential actions only in the dock
